Let the erased number be \(x\). Then

\[
\frac{\frac{N(N+1)}2-x}{N-1}=\frac{45}{4}.
\]

So

\[
x=\frac{2N^2-43N+45}{4}.
\]

For \(x\) to be an integer, \(N\equiv 1 \pmod 4\).  
Also \(1\le x\le N\) gives \(21\le N\le 22\). Thus \(N=21\).

Then

\[
x=\frac{2(21)^2-43(21)+45}{4}
=\frac{882-903+45}{4}
=\frac{24}{4}=6.
\]

\[
\boxed{6}
\]
